description.zh: 一行写一件事、日期放最后，卡片替你数还剩几天
description.en: One line per thing with the date at the end; the card counts the days for you

items.zh: 在下面那个框里写一句话，日期放在最后，回车就加进来。
items.en: Type a line in the box at the bottom with the date last, then press Enter.

items.zh: 四种日期写法：3/15、+3（三天后）、2026-05-01、明天（还有今天和后天）。
items.en: Four ways to write it: 3/15, +3 (in three days), 2026-05-01, or the words today / tomorrow.

items.zh: 日期前面留个空格，标题里带数字也不会被误认（「报告 v1.2」不会被吃掉）。
items.en: Keep a space before the date, so numbers inside a title are not swallowed ("report v1.2" stays whole).

items.zh: 不拒绝也不报错：按明天算，并在卡片顶上明说「没写日期，按明天算」。
items.en: Nothing is rejected: it assumes tomorrow and says so on the top line.

items.zh: 只写 3/15 已经过了今年那天，就算明年 —— 记已经逾期的事请写全年份。
items.en: A short date that already passed this year rolls to next year; to log something overdue, write the full year.

items.zh: 写「今天 / 明天 / 后天 / N 天后」，超过一周就写日期本身（3 月 15 日）。
items.en: It reads today / tomorrow / in N days, and beyond a week it shows the date itself (Mar 15).

items.zh: 逾期标红、三天之内标成强调色，扫一眼就知道该动哪一条。
items.en: Overdue ones go red and anything within three days takes the accent colour, so a glance is enough.

items.zh: 点左边那个圈就算完成，完成的条目会沉到底部并划掉。
items.en: Click the circle to finish something; done items sink to the bottom and get struck through.

items.zh: 删除的 × 在行尾、鼠标停上去才出现，删掉之后顶上给 6 秒撤销。
items.en: The × appears at the end of a row on hover, and after deleting you get six seconds to undo it at the top.

items.zh: 所有「截止日期」卡片看的是同一份清单，不是各记各的。
items.en: Every Deadlines card shows the same list; they are views, not separate lists.

items.zh: 别的卡片改动时，正在输入的那张不会跟着跳，等你停手再对齐。
items.en: While you are typing, another card's change does not jump in; it waits until you stop.

items.zh: 「时钟」用来知道今天是哪天（拒绝时退回本机日期，倒数照样对）。
items.en: Clock tells it what day it is (without it the machine date is used, and the countdown still works).

items.zh: 「存储」用来记住清单；拒绝时卡片照常能用，但关掉就没了。
items.en: Storage remembers the list; without it the card still works but forgets everything when closed.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：一行文字加日期，倒数列按逾期 / 三天内 / 更远分色。
changes.en: First release: one line of text plus a date, with the countdown coloured by overdue, within three days, and further out.

changes.zh: 删除给 6 秒撤销；写盘是串行的，连点也不会丢条目。
changes.en: Deleting offers six seconds of undo, and writes are serialized so rapid clicks cannot drop an entry.
